verdict.rationale: A runtime probe verified from the npm registry that three.js is MIT-licensed, a free permissive license with no pricing component, so there is nothing to reprice for shipped games. However, the evidence shows only the current license; nothing documents its history or a record of no retroactive changes. Missing for 10: evidence of license history or stability over time, a first-party statement on licensing permanence, independent corroboration of no past license or pricing changes.
